title: ui_authority
description: The ONE authority object for a UI surface. Produced once before design and read by every UI phase and by the stop gate. Contract: docs/contracts/ui-authority.md. There is deliberately no second partial decision table anywhere in src/skills/ — A1.1's verify line asserts that.

surface_mode.description: What the surface is FOR. Per-surface, never inherited from PRODUCT.md.

register.description: The design register, unchanged from docs/guidelines/design-modes.md.

change_intent.description: What the run is authorised to move. `preserve` is the strongest constraint and drives the intent-aware stop gate.

reference_maturity.description: How finished the supplied reference is. `wireframe` declares STRUCTURE and never a pixel mandate. `null` means no reference was supplied.

fidelity_mandate.description: Carried from road-to-frontend-fidelity-calibration Phase 0. NOT re-derived here — this field holds that phase's output, and null means that phase has not produced one.

kind.description: Which authority the run builds from. `incumbent` is the answer when no DESIGN.md exists but a coherent incumbent does.

conflicts.description: Surfaced disagreements. A conflict is REPORTED, never silently resolved — an operation whose declared dimensions collide with a constraint appends here and performs no write.

provenance.description: Where each resolved value came from. One entry per resolved field, so a wrong resolution is traceable to its signal rather than to the resolver as a whole.

verification.description: Graft 2 of the parent roadmap. A pass that could not fully run says so rather than passing silently.

degradation_reason.description: Required whenever `verification` is not `verified`. The resolver refuses to emit a degraded object without one.
